data: What is the highest value of F1 for the CRF model on PKU?

The question asks for the highest value of F1 for the CRF model on PKU. From the caption, we know that the figure shows an ablation study of BERT fine-tuning on only the first/embedding layer. The relevant graph is the one labeled (b) PKU. In this graph, there are two lines representing the performance of the CRF model and Softmax model. The line representing the CRF model is blue, and the line representing the Softmax model is red. The F1 score for the CRF model on PKU is approximately 85%. Therefore, the highest value of F1 for the CRF model on PKU is around 85%.
